max-width.$description: Maximum inline size of the transcript.

gap.$description: Space between messages in the transcript.

bg.$description: Solid background of a user bubble.

fg.$description: Text ink in a user bubble.

bg-image.$description: Optional image over the user bubble background.

backdrop-filter.$description: Complete filter behind the user bubble.

max-width.$description: Maximum share of the transcript width a user bubble occupies.

end-radius.$description: Radius of the user bubble at the block-end inline-end corner.

radius.$description: Radius of the user bubble corners.

padding.$description: Block and inline padding inside a user bubble, in that order.

fg.$description: Text ink of an assistant reply on the page surface.
Text and icon ink of a system event on the page surface.

bg.$description: Solid primary container of the default assistant avatar.

fg.$description: Glyph ink inside the default assistant avatar.

bg-image.$description: Optional image over the default assistant avatar background.

backdrop-filter.$description: Complete filter behind the default assistant avatar.

radius.$description: Corner radius of the default assistant avatar.

inline-size.$description: Streaming caret width relative to its message text.

block-size.$description: Streaming caret height relative to its message text.

duration.$description: Period of the streaming caret blink when motion is allowed.
